scope: Tiny paired local contracts;root-owned runtime qualification is separate.

cases.title: Establish a finite restart baseline
cases.input_contract: Run the restart scenario with two supplied records and retain progress plus exact sink values.
cases.verification: Assert the literal bag, input count 2 and inactive query.

cases.title: Prove no-input recovery without a sleep
cases.input_contract: Restart the compatible baseline with its existing checkpoint and no new file.
cases.expected: Same query ID, new run ID, zero new rows and unchanged sink.
cases.verification: Compare identities, input sum and exact bag;allow empty progress entries.

cases.title: Test real streaming duplicate suppression
cases.input_contract: Use native streaming dropDuplicates on the id key for two identical occurrences of 1:100.
cases.verification: Compare input count 2 and the one-row bag.

cases.title: Test the exact event-time boundary
cases.input_contract: Apply the explicitly declared admission cutoff event_second>=90 to rows at 80,90 and 110.
cases.verification: Compare exact two-row bag and explain why 90 is retained.

cases.title: Keep invalid rows visible in the case ledger
cases.input_contract: Reject a NULL identity and a negative amount while retaining valid 3:300.
cases.verification: Compare raw source count 3, actual progress, sink bag 3:300 and static predicate count 2.

cases.title: Prove the oracle rejects a plausible regression
cases.input_contract: Compare the correct duplicate-case bag with an unsafe two-copy append result and reject the mismatch. Confirm every owned query is inactive before cleanup.
cases.expected: Correct bag passes;duplicated bag raises an assertion-contract error;all owned queries are inactive.
cases.verification: Catch the specific mismatch and compare the exact offending rows.

golden.progress_scope: Actual JSON scan progress may reflect predicate pushdown;raw source counts are measured independently
